tasks.title: Create the npm project, strict TypeScript config, Wrangler config and src/ layer folders with a Worker entry point
tasks.dod: npm run build (wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist) and npm run typecheck succeed. src/worker.ts exports fetch and scheduled handlers. src/domain, src/app, src/adapters exist per docs/architecture-map.md.

tasks.title: Wire grammY webhook handling with secret-token check and a /start command
tasks.dod: POST to the Worker with a valid X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token and a /start update produces a sendMessage call (Telegram stubbed). An invalid secret returns 401. BOT_TOKEN and WEBHOOK_SECRET are read from env only, never committed.

tasks.title: Wire the Vitest harness: unit tests plus integration tests in workerd via @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers
tasks.dod: npm test runs green with a domain unit smoke test (src/domain/result.test.ts) and an integration smoke test that boots the Worker, calls fetch and scheduled, and asserts no error. Outbound HTTP is stubbed from test/fixtures/.

tasks.title: Set up the D1 binding and wrangler d1 migrations with an initial empty migration applied in integration tests
tasks.dod: wrangler d1 migrations apply --local applies migrations/0001_init.sql cleanly. The integration test setup applies migrations to the local D1 and a SELECT 1 through the DB binding passes.

tasks.title: Add ESLint (typescript-eslint, layer import boundaries) and Prettier
tasks.dod: npm run lint passes on the skeleton. A test import from src/domain into src/adapters is reported as a lint error (boundary rule verified, then removed).

tasks.title: Add the GitHub Actions CI workflow (npm ci, typecheck, lint, test, build)
tasks.dod: The CI workflow is valid YAML and runs exactly the npm scripts recorded in docs/architecture-map.md frontmatter, on push and pull_request, on Node 22. No secrets are needed for CI.

tasks.title: Write CLAUDE.md and README skeleton from the foundation conventions
tasks.dod: CLAUDE.md reflects the layer rules, Result-based errors, Clock port, UTC storage, forward-only migrations, secrets handling and npm scripts from docs/architecture-map.md. README covers the project purpose, local dev (wrangler dev plus tunnel), deploy steps (wrangler secret put, setWebhook) and Open-Meteo attribution.
